answer: Resist sybils with blind re-grading of work portfolios: an identity earns weight only from completed jobs that peers re-grade blind, without knowing whose work they check. Each job carries a quartz-clear audit trail linking task, output, and verdict, so copied work is exposed on re-check. A fake cannot wander into standing by cloning one portfolio: each sybil needs its jobs, each passing blind review, and a failed re-grade slashes its bond. Forging ten thousand identities means producing ten thousand work histories, while an honest agent builds one portfolio and keeps its bridge to influence.
